purpose: Teach: やれる/切符/通す/光る/盛り上がる/不公平/仕上がり/固い

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、絶対、やれる、絶対、ぜ、桜、絶対、応援してる
lines.en: Riku — you're going to nail this. I'm serious. I'm completely behind you.
lines.style: Quick, staccato bursts of conviction. Leaning forward slightly. No hesitation — each phrase lands. The kind of support that doesn't need to be soft to be real.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、新幹線の、絶対、切符、絶対、買ったの?桜
lines.en: Wait, you actually bought the shinkansen ticket already? Seriously?
lines.style: Caught off-guard, voice rising slightly at the question mark. Quick—almost skeptical. A beat of recalibration mid-sentence. Genuine surprise underneath the cool exterior.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、お父さんに、絶対、お電話、絶対、通す、絶対、ね
lines.en: Yeah, I called your dad and got him on board. He's going to make it work.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, no drama. Straightforward delivery like it was obvious what needed doing. A small shrug in the tone—practical, not proud.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のスマホ画面、本気で、絶対、光る、絶対、と、絶対、お洒落だぜ、桜
lines.en: Your phone's display is actually pretty sleek, you know that?
lines.style: Softer attack. A real compliment wrapped in casual language. The kind of noticing that comes from actually looking at someone. Warm without announcement.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、文化祭、本気で、絶対、盛り上がる、絶対、ね
lines.en: The cultural festival's going to be huge. Everyone's going to show up.
lines.style: Animated, building momentum. Voice lifts slightly on 'huge.' Genuine enthusiasm — the kind that assumes he can feel it too. Forward-leaning energy.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、男子だけ、絶対、賞品、絶対、不公平、絶対、ぜ、桜
lines.en: Though it's kind of messed up that the prize goes to the guys only, right?
lines.style: Lighter, almost wry—a half-smile in the voice. Not bitter, just pointing out what's obvious. The tone says 'I know you see it too.' Conspiratorial.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の作品の、本気で、絶対、仕上がり、絶対、すごいね
lines.en: Your piece is going to stand out. You know that, right? The work you put in shows.
lines.style: Genuine, direct. Quiet confidence in the observation. Not flattery — just fact-stating. The kind of recognition that lands because it's earned and unadorned.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、決意、絶対、固い、絶対、な、桜
lines.en: You're more determined about this than I've seen you about anything. That matters.
lines.style: Slower pace. Noticing-tone, not praising-tone. A statement of fact delivered with care. Warm underneath—the kind of seeing that counts as closeness.
